title: Communicate with Ticwatch E
body: Is it possible to have a MiaoMiao/Freestyle Libre sensor communicate directly with a Ticwatch E watch? We aren't allowed phones on site at work and it would be useful to be able to monitor my sugars using only my watch.

comments.body:
I would be very interested in the answer to this. I have a Samsung phone and a ticwatch e2. 
XDrip on both. 
Can’t get the watch to function reliably as standalone!
Yes, see my post for the parent asking due the standalone watch help. You just have to force the settings within the app on your watch. It will work flawlessly.
Hey Opasha, that's great to know that it is possible. I'm having a little trouble finding the post you mentioned though. Is it possible for you to give a direct link?
Fixed on the latest xDrip Nightly version: https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/commit/f2c33e3e550c0f3b38f11559392199e43940a657
